svg.title: Figure 25.7 — Brood Pattern Interpretation
svg.desc: Comparison of coherent healthy brood and irregular brood requiring investigation; appearance alone is not diagnostic.
svg.text: Compare pattern first; then inspect cells, history, queen status, parasites, nutrition and temperature.
• broad coherent area of capped worker brood
• a few normal gaps can occur
• consider queen, disease, Varroa, nutrition, chilling
Brood pattern is evidence, not a diagnosis. A small number of gaps can be normal; heavy irregularity requires cell-level examination and colony history.
